items.headline: Qwen 3.6 27B Speculative Decoding Bench: Pushing ~100 TPS on a single RTX 3090
items.summary: First of all, a huge thank you to the r/LocalLLaMA community and the 3090 club. This benchmark started from your shared recipes... These are my findings on my hardware (Xeon E5-2666v3, 64GB RAM, single RTX 3090 24GB) comparing 5 engines (3 llama.cpp forks + mainline + Lucebox) across two quantizations of the same model. I've used the bench script from https://github.com/noonghunna/club-3090/tree/master and two simple scripts using en8wiki for building long prompts. Summary Table Sorted by fork →
